scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gestao-sst/shared && concurrently -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @gestao-sst/shared && npm run dev -w @gestao-sst/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gestao-sst/shared && npm run build -w @gestao-sst/api && npm run build -w @gestao-sst/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @gestao-sst/shared && npm run lint -w @gestao-sst/api && npm run lint -w @gestao-sst/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gestao-sst/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gestao-sst/api && npm run typecheck -w @gestao-sst/web
